records.name: PeekPaste
records.tagline: Your clipboard, within reach
records.description: PeekPaste is a native clipboard manager for Mac that stays out of your way until you need it. Push your pointer against the screen edge and your clipboard slides in. Find text, code, links, images, colors and files, search inside screenshots with on-device OCR, pin and organize clips, or open the full Library when you need more. Everything stays on your Mac - no accounts, analytics, telemetry or cloud clipboard service.

records.name: Thoughts for Mac
records.tagline: Capture notes from your menubar using text, images or voice
records.description: Thoughts is a menubar app for your Mac which helps you keep notes quickly using text, images and voice. Add your favorite agent API key and it'll also help transcribe audio, context images to text and help do simple text-tranforms like capitalization, translations and spelling fixes. Think of it as a fun small multi-tool for your menubar.

records.name: Anthropologic
records.tagline: The zero distance consumer research platform.
records.description: Traditional research is deep but slow. Social listening is fast but shallow. LLMs are fluent but culturally blind. Anthropologic reads the whole internet through our 'Human Context Protocol' to uncover consumer, category and cultural truths. Nine workflows, 239 markets, 100+ languages. Research, innovation and foresight answers in minutes.

records.name: Narrative
records.tagline: AI-first video editor, just describe edits & refine in chat
records.description: Narrative brings video editing, custom motion graphics, and reference-video style matching into one interface. Upload your footage, describe your edit, and keep refining through chat. Add music, sound effects, and transitions, or get inspiration from reference videos. From podcast clips to launch videos, create without learning Premiere or After Effects. We handle rendering and storage. Our launch video was made entirely in Narrative.

records.name: siift
records.tagline: Turn AI noise into better business decisions
records.description: Building a business with AI can quickly become a mess of chats, tools, ideas, and conflicting advice. siift turns that noise into a living map of your business, connecting strategy, evidence, decisions, and results in one place. From validation and build strategy to GTM and growth, our AI uses your evolving business context and proven processes to challenge assumptions, identify risks, and help you focus on what matters next.

records.name: OpenAI Agents API
records.tagline: Cloud agents, run on OpenAI's Codex harness
records.description: OpenAI's managed version of the Codex harness to build cloud agents with one API call instead of your own orchestration. Handles long sessions, smart tool use, and subagents working in parallel. Runs on OpenAI or partner sandboxes. No extra fees beyond token and tool usage. Open source harness, public beta now.

records.name: Axari
records.tagline: Assign your security busywork to your AI twin
records.description: Your Axari AI twin understands your security world, works across your tools and teams, and keeps work moving until it is actually done. Assign it a goal, let it work proactively, or give it recurring responsibilities – all from within Slack or MS Teams. Attackers aren't going to use less AI, neither should you. You + your AI twin = indefatigable.

records.name: Voiskey
records.tagline: AI voice typing that sounds right in every app
records.description: Voiskey starts from what you meant, not just what you said. Speak a rough thought and it comes back shaped for where it's going and who's reading it: casual with a friend, composed with a colleague, technical with an AI. It arrives 5x faster than typing, cleaned up and ready to send, while you still sound like you. Voiskey is now available on iOS, macOS, Android, and Windows, in over 100 languages. It's free to start. Join during launch and get a free month of Pro.

records.name: tiun.
records.tagline: Auth, billing, and payments for AI builders
records.description: One system for auth, payments, customer data, and analytics. One command to install. Launch a paid product the same day you start building.

records.name: jurniti
records.tagline: Always-on AI agents in Firecracker microVMs
records.description: jurniti is a private always-on box for your AI agent. Each agent gets its own Firecracker microVM with a KVM hardware boundary, the same primitive AWS uses for Lambda, not a shared Docker container. Bring your own model keys. They stay inside the guest. Pay, and the box is live in about three minutes: in-browser terminal, persistent disk, your subdomain. Claude Code, Codex, Hermes, OpenClaw, and other upstream agents. From $25/mo. 30-day money-back on the first purchase. No free trial.

records.name: Workshopy.io
records.tagline: Turn a Markdown file into a live, trackable workshop
records.description: Write a workshop as one plain Markdown file and run it live. Students join with a code - no accounts - and you see which step everyone is on: who's stuck, who's done, who needs help. Polls, quizzes, chat and a session report built in. Free, no credit card.

records.name: FATHER
records.tagline: A Mac dashboard for site traffic, deploys, uptime, and SEO
records.description: A mission-control dashboard for teams shipping on Vercel. Connect your account and every project fills in live: traffic, deploys, uptime, and PageSpeed scores. Search Console and Bing show clicks, rankings, and indexing. SSL and domain renewals get a countdown, and failing GitHub checks get flagged. When a build fails, the menu-bar F turns red and a notification fires, even with the window closed, so you know a site's down before your clients do. Tokens stay on your Mac. One-time purchase.

records.name: The Minimalist Entrepreneur Skills
records.tagline: Book playbook as Claude Code slash skills
records.description: The Minimalist Entrepreneur as 10 open-source Claude Code skills by Sahil Lavingia. Install the plugin, then run slash commands like /validate-idea, /mvp, /pricing, and /minimalist-review to apply the book to your own business. Free and MIT-licensed on GitHub.

records.name: Buddy AI Access (MCP)
records.tagline: Your agent needs more than your repo
records.description: Give AI agents secure access to your infrastructure and workflow. With Buddy MCP agents can run pipelines, inspect logs, deploy apps, create sandboxes, publish artifacts and manage domains. Control exactly what they can access with workspace permissions and tool scopes. Works with Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, Copilot and other MCP clients.

records.name: Proofrr
records.tagline: One workspace for creative feedback, reviews, and approvals
records.description: Feedback in WhatsApp. Versions in Drive. Approvals lost in email. The review process eats into the actual work. Proofrr is one workspace for creative projects, client feedback, and version control. ✓ Project management for design & video workflows ✓ Side-by-side draft comparison ✓ Annotations & threaded comments ✓ Shareable review links — no client login needed ✓ AI-assisted reviews to speed up feedback

records.name: Idlen
records.tagline: Earn while you work with AI in any IDE or browser
records.description: Developers wait on AI all day. That wait is an ad slot. One network, three doors. If you code: install the VS Code, Cursor or Chrome extension. A native ad while the model thinks. You keep 70%. We don't read your prompts. If you sell a developer tool: you show up in the IDE and the browser, targeted by the stack they actually use (React, Python, AWS). Pay €200, get €400 this week. If you shipped a chat app: npm i @idlen/chat-sdk. Three lines. Ads optional. No key, no ads. You keep 70%.

records.name: Fifi
records.tagline: An alarm that calls you, and reads you your day
records.description: Most alarms are a sound you silence. Fifi is a call you answer. It rings through Silent mode and a Focus — built on iOS 26 AlarmKit, so the alarm needs no network. Your Lock Screen shows an incoming call with a face and a name. Answer, and one of ten characters reads you your day: last night's note, your forecast, your headlines. An ASMR whisper, a film-noir detective, a nature doc, a drill sergeant, a pantomime baroness, a fairy godmother. 39 ringtones. A backup call. A streak.

records.name: Kilo Code for iOS and Android
records.tagline: Start coding agents, control sessions, review PRs. Anywhere.
records.description: Run Cloud Agents, control VS Code and CLI sessions, review Pull Requests, and respond to coding agents from your iPhone, iPad, or Android.

records.name: Mailyte
records.tagline: Email for your team, your app, and your customers.
records.description: Mailyte is the only platform combining team inboxes, transactional/API email, and marketing campaigns in one place — on your own domain. Most teams stitch together Workspace, Postmark, and Mailchimp; Mailyte replaces all three. It's also open source (AGPL-3.0): self-host free on your own hardware, or let us manage it — same product, no lock-in either way. Built-in SPF/DKIM/DMARC checks and a live delivery view keep your mail out of spam, out of the box.

records.name: Kodro
records.tagline: Code robots in an offline Python learning simulator
records.description: Kodro turns robotics learning into one visual loop: Design → Code → Simulate → Prove → Build. Students can assemble robots, program them with Python or blocks, test them in interactive 3D worlds, inspect live sensors and export evidence, all offline-first. Teachers get 24 curriculum lessons plus a lesson creator, while makers can prototype without expensive hardware. No account, cloud connection or AI is required.

records.name: Portfolio Frame
records.tagline: Frame, annotate, and export screenshots that look designed
records.description: Portfolio Frame turns plain screenshots into polished, share-ready images, right in your browser. Capture a full tab, a code selection, or a single element, then add device mockups, backgrounds, and annotations (including a redact tool for blurring out secrets before you share). Export instantly as PNG, JPEG, WEBP, or SVG. Free to use, no account needed. Built for developers and designers who want their work to look as good as it actually is.

records.name: Grimo AI
records.tagline: Say it once and all tasks, calendar and notes are sorted
records.description: Grimo AI turns one spoken or typed sentence into tasks, calendar events, and notes — no forms, no switching apps. Say the words and Grimo files it exactly where it belongs, dated and prioritized. Built for messy weeks: a calendar that shows overlaps at a glance, hands-free voice mode for when your hands are full, and one chat thread so nothing gets lost across five different apps. Free to start. iOS only.

records.name: is.team
records.tagline: Your AI agent joins the board like a teammate
records.description: is.team is an infinite canvas where AI agents and your team plan, build, and ship together — visually. Drag kanban boards and notes onto a spatial workspace. AI agents join via MCP as real teammates — creating tasks, joining conversations, and shipping work alongside your team. Built-in voice rooms, real-time collaboration, GitHub/Slack/Calendar integrations. $16/mo flat for 15 people. Free to start, no credit card needed.

records.name: DynamicLake 2.0
records.tagline: Dynamic Island for Mac with 3rd Live Activities and more
records.description: DynamicLake - Dynamic Island for Mac · Plugins · Notifications · Drag and drop · Converter · Calls · Airdrop · Timer · and more

records.name: Multimodal Agents by Sierra
records.tagline: AI agents that switch between voice, text, and visuals
records.description: Sierra's multimodal agents bring voice, text, and visuals into the same customer conversation. Voice is for explaining what you need, a visual for comparing options side by side, and text for referencing something later. Instead of picking just one, the agent automatically shifts between modes as the conversation needs.

records.name: Tangerine
records.tagline: Offline file modifier for Mac
records.description: Tangerine is a Mac app for converting files simply with Shift-drag. Hold Option for advanced tools. Convert and compress images, videos, audio, PDFs, and archives, remove metadata, redact documents, and annotate photos. All locally, without uploading your files.

records.name: PortAura
records.tagline: See what’s listening on your Mac
records.description: PortAura is a native macOS utility that shows which processes are listening on which ports, where they’re exposed, and what has changed since your trusted baseline. It helps you understand local services without digging through Terminal commands. Everything runs locally on your Mac.

records.name: Payflip
records.tagline: Pay anyone you can name. No IBAN, no wallet address.
records.description: Payflip is a dollar wallet with usernames. Send USDC or USDT to an email, @handle, phone or QR. The recipient picks how to receive, and if they don't claim it, the money comes back to you. Non-custodial. Fee shown before you send.

records.name: Mac Duo
records.tagline: Turn your display into frosted glass as you close the lid
records.description: A macOS app that turns your display into frosted glass as you close the lid. Driven by the hinge sensor, so it moves at the speed of your hand.

records.name: Ravi Free Image Compressor & Resizer
records.tagline: Free Fast Online JPG & PNG Image Compressor & Resize tool
records.description: Free, fast, and secure online image compressor, resizer tool. Compress and resize JPG, PNG, and WebP images instantly in your browser without losing quality. 100% private—your images are processed locally and never uploaded to any server.

records.name: OpenStudio
records.tagline: Free and open-source AI-native digital audio workstation
records.description: Free, open-source DAW for multitrack recording, MIDI, plug-in hosting, pitch editing, mixing, and rendering, with a built-in Neural Amp Modeler guitar rig.

records.name: AGENT-NATIVE
records.tagline: Turn any site into a agent-native version
records.description: AI agents like ChatGPT, Claude and Perplexity now read the web - but your site is built for humans. Agent Native serves them a clean, structured version of your content (semantic HTML + JSON-LD or Markdown) while visitors keep your normal design. Available as a hosted tool for any site or a one-click WordPress plugin, it adds an auto-generated llms.txt, agent rate-limiting, and a privacy-friendly log of which AIs read you. Make your content citable, not just crawlable.

records.name: Enduro Fit
records.tagline: Adaptive Hybrid Fitness
records.description: One adaptive plan for running, strength and HYROX. Enduro Fit reshapes training around real life while you approve every meaningful change.

records.name: Dreamlaunch
records.tagline: Check if GPTBot & ClaudeBot can crawl your site, fre
records.description: Check whether GPTBot, ClaudeBot, PerplexityBot, and other AI crawlers can actually access your site. Free, no login.

records.name: Migration Risk
records.tagline: Run a traffic risk analysis before you migrate.
records.description: Find the pages to prioritise before your website migration. Get a free traffic risk report using your Google Search Console data.

records.name: PortMon
records.tagline: Who has that port?
records.description: PortMon is a macOS menu bar app that maps every listening port to the process, project, and container that owns it. Stop it or restart it in one click.

records.name: CreatorToolBox
records.tagline: Free web utilities and AI tools for content creators
records.description: Free online creator tools for YouTube, Instagram, Facebook and social media. Generate titles, hooks, hashtags, video ideas, descriptions and more.

records.name: CupertinoClicks
records.tagline: Mechanical Keyboard and Mouse Sounds for Mac
records.description: Realistic mechanical keyboard and mouse sounds for Mac. Over 30 switch presets, Tone Pad, a built-in typing trainer, on-screen keyboard overlay, notch visualizer, typing stats, profiles, latency configuration, focus mode, and more.

records.name: AI Reply
records.tagline: Never get stuck on what to say.
records.description: AI Reply helps you write natural replies to any message. Paste a text or upload a screenshot, choose your tone, and get a response you can copy and send in seconds.

records.name: SocialSaver
records.tagline: Download Instagram, FB, TikTok & X videos - free, no login
records.description: SocialSaver lets you download videos from Instagram, TikTok, and Twitter/X in a few clicks — no account, no app install, no watermarks added. Paste a link, get your video. Built for creators, marketers, and anyone who needs to save content for offline use or repurposing, without wrestling with sketchy downloader sites full of ads.

records.name: cameratest.org
records.tagline: Online Webcam Test
records.description: Free webcam test tool to check your camera, capture photos, and download snapshots — secure, browser-based camera test.

records.name: RaterSidekick
records.tagline: One dashboard for your AI contract work and earnings
records.description: Keep your own record of AI contract work across platforms. RaterSidekick automatically tracks your time and tasks, estimates earnings, and checks your records against platform reports. Import past work, spot differences in reported time and pay, and download Evidence Packs to share with support. Built for AI contractors working across sites like Outlier, Mercor and Handshake. RaterSidekick never takes screenshots, logs keystrokes or saves task content.

records.name: Shareboxed
records.tagline: A better way to share files, powered by your own storage.
records.description: Shareboxed makes sharing files and folders simple, fast, and beautiful. Add your files, upload, and share it with a single link. Whether you're sending work to a client, sharing assets with your team, or delivering files to anyone else. And with Bring Your Own Storage, your files don't have to live on Shareboxed. Connect your own storage provider and keep control over where your data is stored, while Shareboxed handles the sharing experience.

records.name: MP3 to MIDI Lab
records.tagline: Convert MP3 or WAV to MIDI free, right in your browser
records.description: Convert MP3 or WAV files into editable MIDI right in your browser — no install, no sign-up. Two modes: a highly accurate piano mode for solo recordings, and an experimental full-song mode for mixed music. Preview the converted MIDI as audio before you download, so you know exactly what you'll get. Uploads are auto-deleted within an hour. Great for producers, students, and anyone learning songs by ear. Built on open-source transcription models (Bytedance PTI & YMT3+).

records.name: ARVideoCards
records.tagline: Swiss-made AR postcards for moments and campaigns
records.description: ARVideoCards turns photos and videos into postcards that come alive in the recipient's phone browser. Send one card for a birthday, holiday or memory, or run a measurable campaign for 100 to 5,000 customers, employees, voters or donors. Organizations can import recipients by CSV and add branded artwork, addresses, a post-video CTA and scan analytics. No app or recipient account is required. One personal card costs USD 4 including worldwide fulfillment. Built in Zürich, Switzerland.

records.name: EBRIS
records.tagline: An AI art critic that measures what it can prove!
records.description: Upload any artwork and EBRIS analyzes it with both mathematical precision and artistic depth. 🎨 Colors named as historical pigments - lamp black, burnt sienna, indigo -not cold hex codes 🏛️ Evidence-based comparison with 300 Metropolitan Museum masterpieces 🔍 Deep readings that only reference what can be verified - silence over fabrication Runs on your device. No sign-up required. Your data stays yours.

records.name: Our Little Paws
records.tagline: A gentle care companion for the dog or cat you love
records.description: Has the dog been fed? Open Our Little Paws and you'll know. Every feeding, dose and walk is logged with who did it and when — no more guessing, no fridge magnet to forget.

records.name: Tec-Pulse
records.tagline: Tools and diagnostics for TikTok Shop GMV Max
records.description: Tec-Pulse is an AI growth manager for TikTok Shop GMV Max sellers. Start with free, no-signup browser tools for ROAS and CPA calculations, TikTok Shop checks, GMV Max diagnostics, and video utilities. For account-level analysis, connect the relevant shop or ad account, review the findings, and confirm any action before it runs. Built for sellers and agencies who want a clearer starting point when performance changes.

records.name: Movotrans
records.tagline: Free marketplace connecting shippers with verified drivers
records.description: Verified drivers bid on your shipment across Romania and to/from the UK. Compare offers, pick your price and the pickup date that works for you. Fast, transparent, and completely free no commission, no hidden fees.

records.name: RoamVista
records.tagline: Virtual travel, real-world sounds, and a little escape
records.description: RoamVista is a quiet window to somewhere else. Explore 120 cities across 74 countries and regions through recorded walks, drives and more. Listen to regional radio, unwind with real nature recordings, or layer 16 sounds in Ambient Mixer. Take the wheel in Infinite Road Trip, with eight generated worlds. Save journeys, sounds, stations and mixes in this browser, and share an exact place or mix by link. Free to use, with no account needed.

records.name: Tallymark
records.tagline: Invoices, subscriptions, and sales pages
records.description: Tallymark is invoicing software for entrepreneurs and small businesses. Connect your Stripe account, send an invoice, setup recurring billing, or create a sales page for your digital product or services.

records.name: EMET
records.tagline: Check AI-touched files against source bytes
records.description: EMET is a small MPL-2.0 CLI that anchors file bytes and re-computes SHA-256 later to report MATCH, DRIFT, or UNVERIFIABLE. It helps reviewers check whether an AI-touched file, prompt, or presented view still matches the source bytes. It does not decide semantic truth or model safety; it keeps byte evidence outside the system being checked.

records.name: PaceOut
records.tagline: Screen time kids can see coming
records.description: PaceOut helps families make screen-time transitions visible. Parents set a daily plan with Apple Family Controls; kids see a simple pace ring and wrap-up warnings. Free for one child, with optional Premium for larger families and remote controls.

records.name: SeedVR2 Image Upscaler
records.tagline: run SeedVR2-3b online. Free, up to 8MPx, no login required
records.description: Upscale your images online with this free AI tool. Scale images by 400% up to 16k! High-quality results, no subscriptions, no sign-up, no paywall

records.name: ToyCAD
records.tagline: The easiest App to Design and 3D Print Toys for Kids
records.description: ToyCAD makes 3D design approachable by starting with something every child already understands: drawing. Its split-screen workspace lets users scribble with a brush in 2D and instantly watch ToyCAD turn the drawing into a smooth 3D shape. Kids can add colors, draw directly on objects, combine shapes, and use beginner-friendly building tools—then export their creations for multicolor 3D printing. No account is needed to start exploring.

records.name: TeamSig
records.tagline: Create professional email signatures in 2 minutes
records.description: Most email signatures look broken or outdated. We built TeamSig to fix that. Create clean, responsive, and beautiful email signatures that work perfectly across Gmail, Outlook, and Apple Mail. No coding required—just pick a template, fill in your data, and look professional today!

records.name: SoundDrop — Discover new music
records.tagline: Discover new music. Share your own.
records.description: Listen to independent artists and discover your next favorite song. Stream free, like tracks and upload your own music on SoundDrop.

records.name: DeployLint
records.tagline: GitHub Actions tailored to your repo, delivered as a PR
records.description: DeployLint scans your repository and previews GitHub Actions matched to application roots, package managers and supported hosts. Review generated workflows and missing credentials before opening a setup PR. Maintenance changes stay reviewable, with commit and plan revalidation. Start with a free assessment and preview; setup and maintenance PRs require an eligible plan.

records.name: Asset Forge
records.tagline: Search 108+ free game asset sources in one place
records.description: Asset Forge is a unified search engine for free game assets. Query 108+ sources at once — 3D models, textures, audio, and UI icons. Filter by license, format, and source. Preview 3D models in-browser. Save to collections and batch-download as organized ZIPs with attribution files included.

records.name: Hakscan Ai
records.tagline: Your AI wrote the code. We check it.
records.description: Hakscan scans repos and live sites people ship with Cursor, Claude, and GPT, then turns raw scanner output into plain-language findings with a fix, not a CVE number nobody asked for. Ownership verification runs server-side before anything scans. Free tier checks one target, manual scans. Pro is $24/month: unlimited targets, weekly re-scans, priority queue. Built for solo founders without a security team, not buyers who already have one.

records.name: PortfolioBuild
records.tagline: Create your CV and portfolio in minutes
records.description: PortfolioBuild helps you create both a professional CV and a portfolio website in one place. Build your CV, choose a layout that fits your field, add your projects, customize your profile, and publish your portfolio online in minutes. It is made for students, developers, designers, freelancers, photographers, and creators who want a simple way to present their experience and work without coding.

records.name: Relayit
records.tagline: Encaisse en Afrique.
records.description: Relayit | Encaisse du Mobile Money et des cartes en Afrique avec une seule API et des liens de paiement.

records.name: Pawprints Dispatch
records.tagline: Powerful AI Case Manager to recovery lost pets
records.description: Unlike passive lost-pet boards that rely on static posts, Pawprints Dispatch active-dispatches an AI Case Manager to dial local shelters, field return calls, execute weekly follow-ups, and email 800+ vets and rescues. Owners get hard proof via a live dashboard with email receipts and playable audio recordings of every completed AI call. Paid plans include a Private Number Shield against scams. A free shareable Beacon Page provides an interactive flyer with direct messaging and comments.

records.name: Limn
records.tagline: Persistent, anchored discussions for GitHub Markdown
records.description: Limn keeps review rationale attached to the Markdown it explains. Select a passage in a public GitHub Markdown file, leave an anchored discussion, and let Limn relocate that thread as nearby edits move. If it cannot relocate confidently, it marks the thread as detached. Threads stay associated with the repository URL and file path, and a read-only MCP interface lets compatible AI tools retrieve the same context.

records.name: PlauderWelle
records.tagline: German chat community to meet new people
records.description: PlauderWelle is a German-language community built around real-time chat, meeting new people and social interaction. Users can join moderated topic-based chat rooms, connect under a nickname and discover conversations with people from Germany, Austria and Switzerland. Unlike traditional social networks, PlauderWelle focuses on direct community interaction instead of feeds and follower counts.

records.name: BeatAPI Agent Toolkit
records.tagline: The professional capability layer for AI agents.
records.description: BeatAPI gives agents and apps one key for lower-priced AI models, social data, and production workflows. Build image, video, research, and automation features without opening a separate account, learning another API, or managing another balance for every provider. Run a real model task or social-data action, then see the result, cost, and status in one place.

records.name: PropelAI Studio
records.tagline: AI proposals, contracts & invoices for freelancers
records.description: Type a one-line brief and AI writes the full professional proposal. Your client opens a link on their phone and e-signs it. Then send the invoice with a Pay Now button — card, bank transfer or USSD. Built for freelancers worldwide.

records.name: ScheduleBuilder.dev
records.tagline: Build a clear weekly schedule, right in your browser
records.description: ScheduleBuilder.dev is a free, no-sign-up weekly schedule maker for students, professionals, and everyday routines. Drag and resize color-coded events, start from Student, Work, or Personal templates, and customize themes or background images. Your schedule stays in your browser and can be exported as a high-resolution PNG, print-ready PDF, ICS calendar, or JSON backup. It makes visual planning fast without accounts, subscriptions, or complicated calendar setup.

records.name: FaceSearch
records.tagline: Turn a face into OSINT.
records.description: FaceSearch is an AI-powered face search engine built for OSINT and digital investigations. Upload a face and discover where visually similar images appear across publicly accessible sources, including social media, news, blogs, videos, and other websites. Investigate suspicious profiles, identify reused images, uncover digital footprints, and connect publicly available information to a visual identity.

records.name: Fortune Cookie AI
records.tagline: Free AI fortune cookie generator
records.description: Free online AI fortune cookie generator. Crack a virtual cookie for today's fortune, or craft custom messages for parties, weddings, and tabletop RPG sessions. No app to install.

records.name: 73hi — AI Images in Your Browser
records.tagline: AI image generation that never leaves your browser
records.description: Generate images with AI in your browser. Z-Image-Turbo runs locally on WebAssembly and WebGPU after a one-time download from Hugging Face. No upload, no signup, no watermark.

records.name: Targenix
records.tagline: Free Facebook & Instagram lead automation for Uzbekistan
records.description: Targenix is a free, no-code platform that turns Facebook & Instagram Lead Ads into instant delivery. Connect your page once and every lead flows in real time to your CRM (Bitrix24, Kommo, amoCRM, Notion, Monday, Salesforce), Telegram, Google Sheets or a CPA network — with delivery analytics, Facebook Conversions API, duplicate protection, comment-to-lead capture and AI auto-replies. No subscription, no credit card. Built for Uzbekistan.

records.name: Orbdit
records.tagline: Orbdit taps you at 11:11, so you never miss your moment.
records.description: Orbdit taps you at 11:11, or any angel number you pick, so you catch the moment and make your wish. Sightings, wishes and notes stay on your phone. No streaks. No notifications you didn't ask for. No ads. Ever.

records.name: Aran'du
records.tagline: AI style validator for legal & institutional Plain Language
records.description: Aran'du is an AI assistant built to refine institutional, legal, and corporate text into Plain Language or culture-aware standards (PT-BR & UK/Indian English). Get real-time style analysis, clarity scores, and instant rewrites without losing technical precision. Secure, privacy-first, and free to start (PRO plan available for long documents).

records.name: convoinvoice
records.tagline: Invoicing the conversations
records.description: convoinvoice turns a sentence into a polished invoice. Built for freelancers and small teams who'd rather work than wrangle billing software.

records.name: Solana Token Scanner
records.tagline: Real-time Solana token discovery with risk analysis
records.description: Discover newly launched Solana tokens in real time. Analyze liquidity, volume, trust scores, momentum, and on-chain risk — completely free, no account required.Solana Token Scanner monitors new Solana token launches every 5 minutes and analyzes each one for: - Trust Score (0-100) based on 6 on-chain factors - Risk flags: LP lock, mint authority, freeze authority - Smart Money detection - Momentum scoring - Holder concentration analysis

records.name: AirGapScribe
records.tagline: Meeting transcription that never leaves your PC
records.description: AirGapScribe records, transcribes and summarizes your meetings 100% locally on Windows — no bot joining your calls, no audio uploaded to any server. Free demo, no account needed. Built for legal, healthcare, banking and anyone who can't risk confidential audio leaving the machine.

records.name: C3Digital

records.name: Workshopy.io
records.tagline: Turn a Markdown file into a live, trackable workshop
records.description: Write a workshop as one plain Markdown file and run it live. Students join with a code - no accounts - and you see which step everyone is on: who's stuck, who's done, who needs help. Polls, quizzes, chat and a session report built in. Free, no credit card.

records.name: An AI Workflow Software
records.tagline: Turn messy workflows into measurable ROI
records.description: We built a software engine that allows your company to quantify operational bottlenecks, model queue/capacity constraints, calculate financial leakage, and automatically produce client-ready improvement recommendations

records.name: FATHER
records.tagline: A Mac dashboard for site traffic, deploys, uptime, and SEO
records.description: A mission-control dashboard for teams shipping on Vercel. Connect your account and every project fills in live: traffic, deploys, uptime, and PageSpeed scores. Search Console and Bing show clicks, rankings, and indexing. SSL and domain renewals get a countdown, and failing GitHub checks get flagged. When a build fails, the menu-bar F turns red and a notification fires, even with the window closed, so you know a site's down before your clients do. Tokens stay on your Mac. One-time purchase.

records.name: The Minimalist Entrepreneur Skills
records.tagline: Book playbook as Claude Code slash skills
records.description: The Minimalist Entrepreneur as 10 open-source Claude Code skills by Sahil Lavingia. Install the plugin, then run slash commands like /validate-idea, /mvp, /pricing, and /minimalist-review to apply the book to your own business. Free and MIT-licensed on GitHub.

records.name: Buddy AI Access (MCP)
records.tagline: Your agent needs more than your repo
records.description: Give AI agents secure access to your infrastructure and workflow. With Buddy MCP agents can run pipelines, inspect logs, deploy apps, create sandboxes, publish artifacts and manage domains. Control exactly what they can access with workspace permissions and tool scopes. Works with Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, Copilot and other MCP clients.

records.name: aisync
records.tagline: Migrate Claude Code & Codex to a new machine like a phone
records.description: Back up and restore your Claude Code & Codex sessions, skills, memories, settings and project code across machines. Local-first, end-to-end encrypted, works with Google Drive, Cloudflare R2, OneDrive, WebDAV, S3 or a USB drive. macOS, Windows, Linux. AGPL-3.0.

records.name: Drilld - Pickleball Trainer App
records.tagline: Adaptive pickleball training, not another drill library
records.description: Other pickleball apps hand you 200 drill videos and leave the hard part to you. Drilld builds today's session from your DUPR, your weaknesses, and what you drilled last. 135 drills, 13 categories, a court diagram on every one. Each drill has 5 tier benchmarks you have to earn: clear one and you pick "nailed it" or "got lucky," and got lucky doesn't advance you. Every 14 days Drilld audits you honestly: READY, STAY, AVOIDING, CALIBRATE, BURNED. Free 14-day trial. iPhone and Android.

records.name: Proofrr
records.tagline: One workspace for creative feedback, reviews, and approvals
records.description: Feedback in WhatsApp. Versions in Drive. Approvals lost in email. The review process eats into the actual work. Proofrr is one workspace for creative projects, client feedback, and version control. ✓ Project management for design & video workflows ✓ Side-by-side draft comparison ✓ Annotations & threaded comments ✓ Shareable review links — no client login needed ✓ AI-assisted reviews to speed up feedback

records.name: Idlen
records.tagline: Earn while you work with AI in any IDE or browser
records.description: Developers wait on AI all day. That wait is an ad slot. One network, three doors. If you code: install the VS Code, Cursor or Chrome extension. A native ad while the model thinks. You keep 70%. We don't read your prompts. If you sell a developer tool: you show up in the IDE and the browser, targeted by the stack they actually use (React, Python, AWS). Pay €200, get €400 this week. If you shipped a chat app: npm i @idlen/chat-sdk. Three lines. Ads optional. No key, no ads. You keep 70%.

records.name: Openhaus Estates
records.tagline: Elevated Design for Modern Estates
records.description: Openhaus Estates is a modern, luxury-focused real estate website template designed to showcase exceptional properties through a clean, editorial-inspired experience. Features: Custom-designed components Global styles for typography and colors Fully responsive for desktop, tablet, and mobile CMS-powered Property Listings CMS-powered Blog Pages No-code build Easy-to-edit sections and components Consistent design system throughout Structured layouts designed for scalability

records.name: tatarverse
records.tagline: catalog
records.description: tatarverse помогает найти татарские, башкирские и крымскотатарские центры по всему миру: для новых знакомств, друзей, отношений, изучения языка, восстановления связи с культурой и поддержки общих ценностей.

records.name: Vloam Mermaid
records.tagline: Live Mermaid editor — private, free, no install
records.description: Vloam Mermaid is a free, browser-based Mermaid diagram editor. Type syntax and get an instant live preview — flowcharts, sequence, class, and more. Diagrams stay on your device (no account, no upload). Export SVG or PNG. English and Chinese. MCP tools so AI agents can validate and render Mermaid too.

records.name: Paper
records.tagline: A notebook that talks back while you write.
records.description: Most AI writing tools try to give you answers or generate something for you. Paper is different. You write normally, and it gives you things to think about based on what you've written. The AI stays in the background, so your thoughts remain the focus. It's a notebook that talks back without trying to do the thinking for you.

records.name: SpiralLink
records.tagline: A social network that translates on your device
records.description: Most social apps assume one language. SpiralLink is an 18+ multilingual social network: write posts, DMs, and blogs once, and they translate on your device so each person reads in their own language. Available on iOS, Android, and the web. Unlike a copy-paste translator, translation is built into the feed, messages, and blogs. Join early and more paid plans stay free while the community grows.

records.name: OfferLoop
records.tagline: A sales CRM for your job search
records.description: Job hunting dies in silence: you apply, you wait, nobody replies. OfferLoop treats your search like a sales pipeline. Paste a job link to capture it, get hourly follow-up nudges with emails pre-written in your voice, one-click interview prep packs, and proof that following up multiplies your interview rate. Free, open source, bring your own Gemini key.

records.name: The God Terminal
records.tagline: A connected worldbuilding operating system built in Notion
records.description: The God Terminal turns scattered worldbuilding notes into one connected Notion system. Built for writers, worldbuilders, TTRPG creators, and narrative designers, it connects characters, factions, locations, bloodlines, events, continuity, story threads, and more across 36 databases. Start with just 5 core records, then expand only when your world needs it.

records.name: Orbit IDE
records.tagline: Scale Game and App Development with Orbit AI Coding Agents
records.description: From prompt to production — Orbit runs your game pipeline as AI agents: Design, Code, Playtest, Deploy, Live. Built for studios: shared context, parallel tasks, and Planning-First review, so every change is approved before it ships — no black box in your production codebase. Builds are auto-verified with a local compiler and smoke tests, then shipped as OTA updates in minutes, bypassing App Store reviews. Time-to-market 3x. Proven in Pianify: 3x plan-to-ship, 4.3/5.0 stars. Invite-only beta

records.name: TRINETRA
records.tagline: Seeing beyond deception with multi-modal AI forensics.
records.description: TRINETRA is a $0-budget, multi-modal AI cybersecurity platform built on FastAPI, React, and Groq. It performs zero-trust digital forensics by locally parsing URLs, Emails, PDFs, QR codes, and images (detecting deepfakes via FFT/ELA) before inference, masking PII to deliver sub-second threat intelligence.

records.name: Quiz8 2.0
records.tagline: Turn any topic into a multiplayer quiz night
records.description: Quiz8 turns any topic into a hosted game night. Enter a subject, get a ready-to-play quiz, and share a code—players join from any phone or browser without accounts. V2 adds teams, live leaderboards, optional power-ups, picture and ordering questions, answer explanations, and post-game reports. For accuracy-critical image rounds, flags, maps, and landmarks come from fixed datasets instead of AI guesses. Free plan: up to 20 players, 7 questions, and 2 topics per game.

records.name: PrivateTranscribe
records.tagline: Local voice dictation for Windows
records.description: PrivateTranscribe is local-first voice dictation for Windows. Press a hotkey, speak, and the text lands in your app. Whisper runs locally by default so your audio stays on your PC. Cloud transcription is optional. Starter is free with 1,000 words/day, all Whisper models, CUDA acceleration, hotkeys, auto-paste, and local history. Pro is a one-time purchase that removes the word cap. Unfinished beta workflows require separate tester approval. Buying Pro does not grant beta access.

records.name: BlackCat
records.tagline: Reality changes when you look. The quantum messenger.
records.description: BlackCat is a sci-fi messenger where messages follow the laws of Quantum Mechanics. You don't 'send' a text; you Box it. They don't 'read' it; they observe it. 📦 Schrödinger's Box: Send 3 texts in superposition. Only 1 survives observation. 🔒 Heisenberg's Lock: View content OR sender. Never both. ⏳ Quantum Zeno: Hold to freeze time. Experience pure OLED black, neon UI, and true kinetic chat powered by ANU Quantum RNG.

records.name: Fifi
records.tagline: An alarm that calls you, and reads you your day
records.description: Most alarms are a sound you silence. Fifi is a call you answer. It rings through Silent mode and a Focus — built on iOS 26 AlarmKit, so the alarm needs no network. Your Lock Screen shows an incoming call with a face and a name. Answer, and one of ten characters reads you your day: last night's note, your forecast, your headlines. An ASMR whisper, a film-noir detective, a nature doc, a drill sergeant, a pantomime baroness, a fairy godmother. 39 ringtones. A backup call. A streak.

records.name: Kilo Code for iOS and Android
records.tagline: Start coding agents, control sessions, review PRs. Anywhere.
records.description: Run Cloud Agents, control VS Code and CLI sessions, review Pull Requests, and respond to coding agents from your iPhone, iPad, or Android.

records.name: Circle Calculator
records.tagline: Circle math for students, machinists, and Minecrafters.
records.description: Circle Calculator brings 14 tools into one place: basics, arcs, chords, sectors, tangents, circle equations, 3-point circles, triangle-circle relationships, ellipse comparisons, a Minecraft block-circle generator, and a bolt-circle PCD calculator for machinists. Each tool ships with a written guide covering the formula and a worked example — not just a black-box result. No login, no paywall.

records.name: Tapechild UDS-16
records.tagline: Rare Soviet drum synth character. No samples.
records.description: Build your own drums with a 16-voice synthesizer inspired by the Lel UDS and Formanta Rockton. Four synthesis models generate every hit in real time: no samples. Shape tone, noise, attack and decay, then add tape saturation and gated reverb. Available for Mac (VST3, AU, standalone) and Windows (VST3, standalone). $49 once, up to three computers, no iLok. Hear audio demos on our website.

records.name: OmniNova
records.tagline: The Premier Global Service Marketplace
records.description: OmniNova connects customers with trusted businesses, professionals, and services worldwide, while helping businesses showcase their services and get discovered online.

records.name: Parcel Relay
records.tagline: Rotate whole rows. Deliver the parcel.
records.description: A free browser puzzle where each click rotates a whole row of tracks. Deliver parcels through numbered stops across 50 routes, try the daily board, or share the same puzzle with a friend. Undo, hints, and local progress included. No account, download, or timer.

records.name: MyShopRender
records.tagline: AI drafts listings for Etsy, eBay, Depop, Vinted & Shopify
records.description: AI listing automation for Etsy, eBay, Depop, Vinted and Shopify. Drop in your photos, AI writes the listing and fills every field automatically.

records.name: Bakemark
records.tagline: A calm, ad-free home for the recipes you actually make
records.description: Recipe sites have become impossible to use: life stories before the ingredients, popups between every step. Bakemark is the opposite. Paste any link, drop a PDF, or snap Grandma's handwritten card and AI turns it into a clean recipe on your shelf. Scale servings, cook hands-free with voice mode, and build offline shopping lists as you go. Share any recipe as a beautiful ad-free page friends can save to their own shelf in one tap. Free on iPhone, Android, and web.

records.name: Vibe BI
records.tagline: The Looker Studio alternative for agencies who outgrew it
records.description: Vibe BI syncs GA4, Google Ads, Meta Ads & Search Console into one ClickHouse-powered dashboard — no GA4 API quotas, no surprise BigQuery bills, no manual calculated fields. Reports load in milliseconds, not seconds.

records.name: Amadae
records.tagline: Accounting, tax and banking for creators, in one place
records.description: Amadae is an accounting, tax and banking firm for creators, coaches, consultants and online business owners. Your books update in real time, quarterly estimates are calculated for you, and a real team plans your taxes before year end instead of after. Business banking, invoicing and payments live in the same workspace, and Mo, the built-in AI operator, answers questions and does the work over chat. Members save about $10,000 a year on taxes.

records.name: Prime Deals US
records.tagline: Category-filtered Amazon deal alerts on Telegram
records.description: Prime Deals is a 1-on-1 Telegram bot that eliminates deal alert fatigue. Instead of broadcasting 100 random items to a loud channel, it lets you pick only the categories you care about (Tech, Home & Tools, Gaming, Fashion, etc.). It leaves you alone until a verified popular price drop, coupon glitch, or all-time low drops in your chosen categories. Includes honest price comparisons, verified cart promo codes, and 1-click access. 100% free with no ads, paywalls, or subscriptions.

records.name: Trekr
records.tagline: One app for your group trip: map, plan, split, and chat
records.description: Group trips usually run on four different apps: a group chat, a shared note, Splitwise, and Find My. Trekr puts all of it in one private Trek your friends join with a short code. See everyone on a live map and drop a pin to meet up. Build the itinerary together. Split costs in any currency, and Trekr works out who owes whom in the fewest payments. Chat, share photos, and get a shareable Recap card when the trip ends. Location sharing is set per Trek and turns off with one tap. Free on iPhone.

records.name: FlexPlayer Studio
records.tagline: Turn any video into a beautiful experience
records.description: FlexPlayer is a modern, highly customizable video player built for beautiful experiences. Stream HLS/DASH, switch quality and speed, use PiP, subtitles, ambient lighting, HDR & color enhancement, annotations, sharing, analytics, branding, and more. Generate embeds through FlexPlayer Studio or REST API, export for HTML and Android, and integrate it anywhere with a flexible, developer-friendly setup.

records.name: VoiceRecord
records.tagline: Stop transcribing meetings. Start completing them.
records.description: Hello 👋, Most meeting tools give you transcripts. We give you finished work. 💭 THE PROBLEM You're in a Zoom call. Your manager says: "Update the client on the spec, create a ticket for the Q3 deliverables, schedule a follow-up for next week." 🎤 HOW IT'S DIFFERENT FROM OTTER/FIREFLIES - Otter = "here's your transcript" (still 30 min of work) - Fireflies = "here's a summary" (helpful, but you still write everything) - VoiceRecord = "here's your email, ticket, and calendar invite" (1 click each)

records.name: Mailyte
records.tagline: Email for your team, your app, and your customers.
records.description: Mailyte is the only platform combining team inboxes, transactional/API email, and marketing campaigns in one place — on your own domain. Most teams stitch together Workspace, Postmark, and Mailchimp; Mailyte replaces all three. It's also open source (AGPL-3.0): self-host free on your own hardware, or let us manage it — same product, no lock-in either way. Built-in SPF/DKIM/DMARC checks and a live delivery view keep your mail out of spam, out of the box.

records.name: Kodro
records.tagline: Code robots in an offline Python learning simulator
records.description: Kodro turns robotics learning into one visual loop: Design → Code → Simulate → Prove → Build. Students can assemble robots, program them with Python or blocks, test them in interactive 3D worlds, inspect live sensors and export evidence, all offline-first. Teachers get 24 curriculum lessons plus a lesson creator, while makers can prototype without expensive hardware. No account, cloud connection or AI is required.

records.name: ZenCompiler
records.tagline: Write, compile, run, and visually inspect code
records.description: Write, compile, run, debug, and visually inspect C, C++, Python, Java, JavaScript, TypeScript, Go, Rust, and C# directly in your browser with ZenCompiler. Get high-speed cloud sandboxes, an interactive PTY terminal, a step-by-step memory visualizer, and ZenOS, a browser-based desktop workspace for coding, projects, files, notes, developer tools, and more.

records.name: Portfolio Frame
records.tagline: Frame, annotate, and export screenshots that look designed
records.description: Portfolio Frame turns plain screenshots into polished, share-ready images, right in your browser. Capture a full tab, a code selection, or a single element, then add device mockups, backgrounds, and annotations (including a redact tool for blurring out secrets before you share). Export instantly as PNG, JPEG, WEBP, or SVG. Free to use, no account needed. Built for developers and designers who want their work to look as good as it actually is.

records.name: Grimo AI
records.tagline: Say it once and all tasks, calendar and notes are sorted
records.description: Grimo AI turns one spoken or typed sentence into tasks, calendar events, and notes — no forms, no switching apps. Say the words and Grimo files it exactly where it belongs, dated and prioritized. Built for messy weeks: a calendar that shows overlaps at a glance, hands-free voice mode for when your hands are full, and one chat thread so nothing gets lost across five different apps. Free to start. iOS only.

records.name: WhoLocks
records.tagline: find file-locking processes and close them.
records.description: Can’t delete a file or folder because Windows says it’s in use? WhoLocks helps you find the process holding it open and end that process when needed.

records.name: Insightios
records.tagline: Discover what makes your customers buy, in their own words.
records.description: Insightios delivers done-for-you Voice of Customer research reports for DTC brands, agencies, and founders. We analyze real conversations across online communities and social platforms to produce a structured report covering customer language, pain points, and buying triggers. Built for founders and marketers who want to write better copy and sharpen their positioning without surveys, focus groups, or a research budget.

records.name: is.team
records.tagline: Your AI agent joins the board like a teammate
records.description: is.team is an infinite canvas where AI agents and your team plan, build, and ship together — visually. Drag kanban boards and notes onto a spatial workspace. AI agents join via MCP as real teammates — creating tasks, joining conversations, and shipping work alongside your team. Built-in voice rooms, real-time collaboration, GitHub/Slack/Calendar integrations. $16/mo flat for 15 people. Free to start, no credit card needed.

records.name: marqee
records.tagline: Paste a URL, get a product video you can edit shot by shot
records.description: Most AI video tools hand you pixels. If the third shot is wrong, your only move is to generate the whole thing again and hope. marqee reads your live site, writes a script from your own copy, and designs every shot as real code. What comes back is a beat sheet plus editable shots: re-time a shot, rewrite a line, change the accent colour, then re-cut for a fifth of the cost. Nothing is invented, so anything your page cannot support is left out. Two 25 second films free, no card.

records.name: SvgUp
records.tagline: Turn words & images into production-ready SVGs
records.description: Most AI image tools hand you a flat PNG. SvgUp gives you a clean, well-structured SVG you can actually edit. Describe the logo, icon, sticker, illustration or pattern you want and get a production-ready vector file. Upload a PNG or JPG and the Vectorizer turns it into an editable SVG. Refine with one prompt - new colors, layout, details - without starting over. Files open in Figma, Illustrator and Inkscape. Free credits on sign-up, commercial license on paid plans.

records.name: Mono - Postless & Capless 510 Cartridge
records.tagline: Wholesale postless, capless 510 cartridge — under $1 landed
records.description: A postless 510 cartridge has no center post: the coil sits in a sintered ceramic bucket with an embedded FeCrAl element. Capless means no press-fit cap — you fill through a self-sealing silicone septum, so the capping station comes off the line entirely. Mono is our patent-pending build of that format. Transparent terpene-resistant polyamide tank instead of glass, peroxide-cured FKM base seal, 510 thread. Sold wholesale to extract producers. Under $1 landed. Free samples at postlesscart.com.

records.name: Product City: Your AI Career Agent
records.tagline: A year ago this was an idea. Today it's your Signal.
records.description: A year ago we launched here as an early idea. Since then: live on iOS & Android, anonymous ratings building your Signal, AI-guarded against spam, skills ranked into Streets, and 100+ brand deals for showing up. Same mission. Real product now. You're invited! 💐

records.name: RTF to PDF Converter
records.tagline: Free online tool to convert RTF documents to PDF instantly
records.description: Convert RTF to PDF online and keep headings, lists, spacing, and page structure. Preview the finished PDF before you download it.

records.name: Koroot
records.tagline: AI-built digital business cards for the Gulf
records.description: Snap your paper card or type a line about yourself, and Koroot's AI builds a bilingual digital business card. Share it by NFC tap, QR or link, keep it in Apple Wallet, and edit it any time. No app needed for the person you meet.

records.name: UniversalCalc
records.tagline: Free calculators for money, health and everyday math
records.description: 24 free online calculators in English and Spanish: take-home pay and self-employment tax, loans, mortgage, compound interest, BMI, calories, ovulation, running pace, days between dates and more. No sign-up and nothing to install. Every calculator shows the formula and the official figures behind the result, with worked examples, and any calculation can be shared as a link.

records.name: JobConnect AI
records.tagline: AI job matching for remote & cross-border careers worldwide
records.description: Most job boards assume you're already in the country where the job is posted. JobConnect AI doesn't We match professionals with remote-friendly, cross-border roles using AIwith a visible match score (0-100),in 11 languages, across 63 countries Built for the diaspora, digital nomad, and anyone who wants to work globally without relocating.AI-powered CV, cover letter, interview prep & salary intel included Built for the international professional who wants to work globally without relocating first

records.name: WordCountOnline
records.tagline: Free word counter with built-in AI writing tools
records.description: A fast, free word & character counter with no signup — plus a small AI toolkit for writers and marketers: AI-powered writing analysis, an Ad Copy Checker for platform character limits, and an AI Visibility Checker showing how brands appear in AI search answers. Core tools are free; a $6.99 one-time Pro license unlocks extra AI usage.

records.name: Rolomine
records.tagline: Find the most valuable people already in your network
records.description: Rolomine uses AI to analyze your professional network against any goal and surfaces the people worth contacting—customers, partners, investors, advisors, and introductions—with clear reasoning for every match.

records.name: ProPaving
records.tagline: AI pavement area, stall counts and stripe lengths
records.description: ProPaving turns satellite imagery into a reviewable paving takeoff. AI traces pavement boundaries and landscape cutouts, places stall dots, and measures painted stripes in linear feet. Find a lot by address or move around the map, then watch the drawing take shape. Try a free pavement preview on your own lot. Paid plans unlock measurement totals, AI striping tools and PDF exports. Built for paving, sealcoating and striping contractors.

records.name: CareerBest
records.tagline: Real jobs only. No spam listings, no retyping applications.
records.description: Career Best is a job search assistant that keeps watching trusted job boards for you, ranks every opening against your resume so the best fits show up first, and keeps all of your applications in one organized tracker. It can also fill in application forms for you to check over before anything is sent. It is free to use right now.

records.name: Klipche
records.tagline: UGC video from vetted Bulgarian creators, rights included
records.description: Klipche is a Bulgarian marketplace where brands order short vertical UGC videos from vetted creators. Public prices and portfolios, payment held until the video is approved, usage rights chosen before the order and recorded in an automatic contract, one brief and one payment for multi-creator campaigns. Brands can also run campaigns from Claude or ChatGPT through our MCP server, with every payment confirmed by a human.

records.name: IntelBrief
records.tagline: Automated competitor tracking for B2B SaaS teams
records.description: Most B2B SaaS teams track competitors manually — checking pricing pages, reading blogs, setting Google Alerts. It's slow and you always miss something. IntelBrief automates it. Add a competitor URL and we monitor their pricing, product pages, hiring, and messaging. When something changes, you get a clean brief in your inbox. $9/month. No Crayon, no Klue, no $2k/month contracts.

records.name: ModernTex
records.tagline: A native macOS LaTeX editor built for academic manuscripts
records.description: ModernTex is a native macOS editor built around the academic manuscript workflow, not general LaTeX editing: multi-file navigation, synced PDF preview, BibTeX autocomplete by author or title, compile errors rewritten in plain language, submission-readiness checks, and an anonymized export for double-blind review. Free 7-day trial, no account, then $10 once with updates included. Needs macOS 14+ and a TeX distribution; ModernTex offers a one-click TinyTeX install if you don't have one.

records.name: Antiquity IQ
records.tagline: A history trivia game, which tests your knowledge of eras
records.description: Antiquity IQ, is a simple history trivia game which tests users knowledge on historical eras. It was built in html, css and js, I built it as a small project to hone coding skills. I initially was using an open trivia db api, but that meant my game would be reliant on open trivia, so I just made an array of questions instead. I just built the game because I like history.

records.name: CineMap 2.0
records.tagline: Where to stream it - and where it was filmed
records.description: CineMap answers two questions about any film or show: where you can stream it, and where it was actually filmed. The first version did availability only - search a title, see which platforms carry it across 8 countries. New in 2.0 is set-jetting: real filming locations for 27 films and shows across 9 countries, from Emily in Paris (42 spots) to Skyfall and Game of Thrones, built from TMDB, IMDb and Wikidata. Free, no signup, nothing to install.

records.name: Zinq
records.tagline: AI-powered workspace for private investors
records.description: Zinq is an AI-powered workspace built for private investors. Review investment opportunities, organize portfolio and pipeline information, manage source documents, map relationships, and turn fragmented investment data into structured insights - all in one place. Zinq is a workflow and analysis tool, not investment advice.

records.name: NekoLock
records.tagline: A cat blocks your doomscroll — literally
records.description: Open a distracting app, and a cat appears. NekoLock is a gentle app blocker that adds a small pause before mindless scrolling — instead of relying on willpower alone, it helps you stop and decide if you really want to continue. Pet the cat to unlock: 5/10/15 min free, or customize 1–60 min with a cooldown on Plus. Meet different cats, build affinity, and review your habits in a usage report. No account required.

records.name: Stockrankr
records.tagline: Objective ranking of 10,000+ US stocks & ETFs
records.description: Just like in sports, investors also need objective rankings. We rank 10,000+ US stocks and ETFs by their actual returns over several timeframes. For risk, we focus on drawdown — how much an equity has dropped, as many investors find it more relatable. We also rank by the Risk-Return-Ratio, the returns divided by the drawdown, a metric our founder established in 2010. Every equity also gets its own Stockrankr Matrix™ — a 3×3 grid displaying consistency across time and metrics.

records.name: Pascal
records.tagline: A new medium for enterprise software
records.description: A programmable platform that turns company data and processes into operational software that evolves with your company. Pascal gives agents an environment to execute complex workflows and enterprises the infrastructure to automate their operations.

records.name: OpsGlance
records.tagline: Know in 3 seconds if your AWS is on fire
records.description: AWS monitoring for one-person teams. Multi-account, multi-region health on your phone and wrist, pushed the moment it breaks. Your read-only AWS keys never leave the device (Keychain only, no accounts, no tracking, no backend reading your data). Covers CloudWatch alarms, EC2, RDS, ECS, Lambda, SQS, deploys, billing anomalies and more. Home Screen widgets and a full Apple Watch app with complications. Free forever for one AWS account; Pro adds unlimited accounts and real-time push.

records.name: Sperm Race
records.tagline: A hilariously chaotic sperm-racing game for mobile
records.description: Sperm Race is a fast, absurd mobile racing game — you guide sperm cells through hilariously chaotic obstacle courses. 4 game modes (Racing, Adventure, Derby, Survival) and 120+ levels of pure chaos. Free to play with an optional ad-removal upgrade, no forced downloads. Built solo by JohnIsKing Games. Live now on Google Play.

records.name: SUMMECA
records.tagline: AI, SaaS & digital tools for faster business
records.description: SUMMECA brings practical SaaS apps, AI-powered tools, and ready-to-use digital products together in one place. Built for modern businesses that want to automate repetitive work, improve everyday workflows, and move faster.

records.name: FiniteQuest
records.tagline: https://finitequest.com/uniform-bar-examube-practice-test/
