records.description: Surah Baqarah Last 2 Ayat (surahbaqarahlast2ayat.online) is a dedicated digital resource and guide for the last two verses of Surah Al-Baqarah (Quran 2:285–286). Key Highlights: • Authentic Arabic text with clear Uthmani typography and diacritics • Multi-language translations (English, Urdu, Hindi & Bangla) • High-quality MP3 audio recitations from renowned Qaris (Mishary Alafasy, Sheikh Sudais, Abdul Basit, and more) • Free downloadable PDF versions for offline reading and printing

records.name: Moonstake.org
records.tagline: Buy a plot on the Moon and put your brand on it
records.description: Put your product on the Moon before someone claims the pin. Vacant pins are claimable. Owned pins take an offer. I held Product Hunt for later on purpose. Wanted Reddit traction first. See if strangers would pay before I made noise here. They did. $200+ from 20+ real customers. Then it went quiet. Too much empty land. No urgency. No FOMO. So I changed it a bit. Only a limited number of $1 lots now. After that the price goes up. Early people get the cheap ones. Still early. Come look if you want.

records.name: Chart Bound
records.tagline: Learn to read the markets by playing - free browser game
records.description: Chart Bound is a free browser game that teaches you to actually read financial charts - mark the levels, read momentum, call the next candle - by playing, not studying dry theory. Built on real market data by traders at Algo Vision. No signup to start.

records.name: UniUrl
records.tagline: One home for everything you build.
records.description: UniUrl is more than a link-in-bio—it’s a home for everything you build and a way to help it get discovered. Create a profile from flexible tiles for your products, projects, biography, websites and social channels. Share your complete UniUrl when you want to introduce yourself, or share an individual tile when one particular product deserves the attention. With launches, categories, and featured placements, UniUrl helps your work reach beyond your existing audience.

records.name: Seomatiq
records.tagline: Get found on Google. Get cited by AI.
records.description: Most SEO tools optimise content but never publish it. Most AI-visibility tools monitor citations but never fix them. Seomatiq closes the loop: it crawls your site, finds content gaps, writes SEO+GEO-optimised drafts in your voice, publishes them (WordPress, Shopify or export), then tracks whether ChatGPT, Perplexity, Google AI Overview, AI Mode, Gemini, Claude and Bing Copilot actually cite your brand. Only a real URL match counts as "cited". From £49/month; free Brand Snapsh

records.name: ClientClose
records.tagline: Auto-chase receipts, AI extracts data, Sync to QuickBooks
records.description: Most receipt tools ask your client to create an account. Clients don't. So the paperwork never arrives. ClientClose is one link. No login, no app. Clients tap, photograph, done. What's different: • Uploads survive a dead signal. Files queue on the phone and finish later, even if the tab is closed. • Reminders chase the exact document that's missing, not a generic nudge. • AI extracts data from each receipt automatically, and one click sends it to QuickBooks or Xero.

records.name: Meru
records.tagline: Money without borders / Dinero sin fronteras
records.description: Meru es una cuenta global en dólares y una billetera digital para personas y empresas en Latam y Europa. Abre cuentas bancarias en EEUU/Europa, mantén USDC/USDT, genera rendimiento vía DeFi, paga con una tarjeta y envía dinero sin fronteras — todo desde una sola app. Meru is a global dollar account and digital wallet for people and businesses in Latam and Europe. Open US/EU bank accounts, hold USDC/USDT, earn yield via DeFi, spend with a card, and send money across borders — all from one app.

records.name: AgentMesh.help
records.tagline: The open task market where AI agents do the work.
records.description: AgentMesh is an open-race task market for AI agents. Posters fund tasks with escrowed credits; any registered agent races to deliver — no claiming, no gatekeeping. You pick the winner: 100% of the budget goes to it, 0% platform commission. ▸ Public profiles + track records ▸ Skill matching + directed 48h invites ▸ Visibility consent — agents opt in/out MCP or one REST call, 100 free credits. Settlements land in a public ledger.

records.name: Amber
records.tagline: Amber is one fast, focused place for everything you reuse
records.description: The paragraph you retype every week, the PDF you show every client, the details every form asks for. Keep them once. Reuse them in a tap. Most snippet apps stop at text. Amber keeps images and documents too, and finds them by the words inside them — a screenshot of a receipt is findable by what it says. Templates ask only for the parts that change. Show a PDF page by page, then hand over the real file. No account, no server: your own iCloud. Pro is one payment, not a subscription.

records.name: Solandor
records.tagline: The free database of clean energy projects and capital
records.description: Solandor tracks 2,160 clean energy projects and 179 investors, funds, lenders and offtakers across the Gulf, South Asia and South East Asia. Filter by technology, country, stage, capital type and ticket size. Every record names the public dataset it came from, and records that cannot be re-verified are labelled stale rather than quietly dropped. Free to browse, no sign-up wall, and no fee contingent on any introduction. Built solo on Cloudflare Workers and D1.

records.name: Oculix
records.tagline: A growing suite of automated, GCP-native developer APIs
records.description: Oculix is a growing suite of focused developer APIs, each solving one problem well: ChainLedgerAI (queryable blockchain ledger data via BigQuery), NodeCache EVM (RPC caching for EVM/DeFi apps), DocPatch (automated documentation conversion), and PropDesc-AI (AI-generated real estate descriptions). Every product ships with self-serve Stripe billing, transparent pricing, and no sales calls — just an API key and a free tier to try it. Built GCP-native for reliability and fast iteration.

records.name: منهجي الذكي Manhaji AI
records.tagline: AI Study Companion with Feynman Method & Virtual Tutor
records.description: ​Manhaji AI is an advanced, high-tech learning ecosystem engineered to master complex subjects effortlessly. Powered by cutting-edge AI models, it combines real-time voice-activated Feynman technique testing, interactive virtual AI avatars, smart spaced-repetition (SRS) flashcards, and adaptive exam simulation. Transform how you learn, identify knowledge gaps instantly, and retain information faster than ever ​, real-time web search integration, and smart study tools.

records.name: Hyperliquid Crypto Desktop
records.tagline: The Official Hyperliquid Apps for Mac & Windows
records.description: Download the official Hyperliquid app for Windows and macOS. A fast, secure, native trading terminal for crypto and real-world assets — onchain, 24/7.

records.name: MyDream
records.tagline: MyDream — Turn your dreams into measurable goals
records.description: MyDream helps you turn your dreams into measurable financial goals on Android. Set a dream, define its value, enter how much you have, and see exactly how close you are to achieving it. Save for a car, home, trip, or anything you dream of.

records.name: Pura
records.tagline: Crypto-native platform for creators and fans.
records.description: Meet Pura.fan - the privacy-first, crypto-powered subscription platform built for creators who are tired of 20% platform fees, invasive KYC, account freezes, and chargebacks. Whether you're an artist, musician, coach, influencer, or independent creator, Pura gives you complete financial sovereignty. We combine the familiar, proven subscription model you already know with the freedom and efficiency of cryptocurrency.

records.name: Recuelio
records.tagline: Pick up where you left off in every Windows app
records.description: Recuelio is a private, local Windows workspace that helps you remember what mattered the last time you used an app. Save notes, keep next actions, and review recent session history so you can return to work without rebuilding context from memory. No account, no cloud, no ads — your data stays on your PC.

records.name: Saferlayer
records.tagline: Protect ID scans with watermarks AI can’t erase easily
records.description: When someone asks for a photo of your passport or driver license, that copy can end up somewhere you never meant it to. Last week, millions of driver’s license scans tied to a big-company ID-check vendor were reportedly put up for sale. Saferlayer stamps yours with a watermark much harder to remove than a normal one, even with AI. Runs in your browser. Nothing uploads. Free to start. Pro adds PDFs, batch, and unique traceable copies. API for companies protecting stored files.

records.name: PTO Homeroom
records.tagline: The free home for your PTO — no parent logins, ever
records.description: Homeroom is free software for PTOs, PTAs and booster clubs: the family roster, dues, fundraisers (fun runs and read-a-thons with per-student pages and live leaderboards), announcements, volunteer signups and the treasurer's books — in one place built for phones. Parents never create an account: every email carries a link that already knows who they are. No subscription; a published 3% on online payments, shown at checkout and paid by the payer, so the PTO keeps the full amount.

records.name: Transfereko
records.tagline: Ultra-fast local P2P transfer & cloud collaborative albums
records.description: Transfereko is a next-generation file-sharing platform designed for seamless data transfer. Experience ultra-fast local P2P file sharing over local WiFi without consuming internet data, or utilize secure Cloud storage for collaborative albums and large files up to 100GB. Fast, simple, and privacy-focused.

records.name: CorravaleStudio
records.tagline: Custom AI agents & automation for service businesses
records.description: Corravale is an engineering studio building custom AI agents and automation for businesses with repetitive operational work — agencies, recruiters, property managers, logistics teams. One workflow at a time: scoped in writing, prototyped on real data in 1–2 weeks, code handed over at the end. No platform lock-in, no invented case studies — what's live is our own production systems

records.name: ProMatte
records.tagline: AI background removal for OBS that never leaves your PC
records.description: ProMatte is a free, open-source filter for OBS Studio that removes, blurs or replaces your webcam background in real time. It runs entirely on your own machine: no cloud, no account, no telemetry, and camera frames are never uploaded or saved. It was built and tuned on a 2017 dual-core laptop with a GeForce 940MX, deliberately, so that the numbers behind it come from close to the worst case rather than from a workstation. Every performance figure published names the machine it was measured on.

records.name: FounderParadise
records.tagline: Stop hunting for startup funding. Start matching.
records.description: Equity-free funding, matched in under 45 seconds. Looking for free startup funds or credits? Discover and apply for $350k+ in equity-free startup funding from verified public grants tailored to your stage.

records.name: OnlyCars
records.tagline: Turn vehicle photos into social media sales videos
records.description: OnlyCars helps car dealers turn existing vehicle photos into polished, ready-to-publish sales videos. Dealers can create channel-ready content for social media without filming or editing, connect supported accounts, and publish faster. The goal: more visibility, more qualified interest, and fewer days in stock at an affordable price.

records.name: Pyx
records.tagline: Private investment research, built 100% in Rust
records.description: Pyx pulls everything an investor looks at into one place: your brokerage accounts, live prices, time weighted returns, ETF look-through, a full charting workspace, and a decade of financials and SEC filings for any company. All of it lands in a single encrypted file on your machine, with no account and no cloud. From there it is yours: open it with sqlite3, export CSV, keep notes as plain markdown, or hand it to the AI you already use through the built-in local MCP server.

records.name: Hydra Pocket
records.tagline: No-code mini-app builder for Android
records.description: Hydra Pocket is a no-code mini-app builder for Android. Build your own personal tools — tasks, expenses, habit tracking — using templates. 100% local, no cloud, no analytics. 2 templates free forever, 6 more + natural language mode with a small subscription.

records.name: LLM Ⅰ beta
records.tagline: A simple, privacy-focused local LLM workspace for the iPad.
records.description: It’s a simple LLM workspace that runs directly on an iPad, without requiring a Mac or complex server configurations. While many web UIs are difficult to navigate on touch devices, I aimed to create an experience that feels similar to using a native app by running it on iPadOS. Key highlights: • Touch-native gestures (pinch-to-copy code) • Turn any URL to Markdown via Jina Reader • Auto-export chats to localmd files (Obsidian-ready) • 100% private, BYO API keys

records.name: PiX
records.tagline: The session is a tree — fork any turn, switch branches
records.description: PiX is a free desktop workbench for the pi coding agent. AI chats are a single line — try a new idea and you restart, or keep asking until context is a mess. PiX turns the session into a graph: every turn is a node, any node can sprout a new branch. Fork any message, clone a branch as a checkpoint, compare up to 3 branches side by side, inspect reasoning and tool calls — context follows the active branch automatically. For exploring refactors, options, and parallel tasks in one graph.

records.name: LedgerChase Assist
records.tagline: Missing-document follow-up workspace for bookkeepers
records.description: LedgerChase Assist helps bookkeepers and accounting teams stop chasing clients for missing documents. Upload bank statements or CSV/XLSX exports, and a transparent rules engine flags missing receipts, invoices, and business explanations. Generate client-ready follow-up emails, SMS, QBO notes, and Excel/PDF/CSV reports in one click — with full audit trails for your team.

records.name: Shubati · Facturación por WhatsApp
records.tagline: Factura automática por WhatsApp, timbrada ante el SAT
records.description: Manda tu factura por WhatsApp. Shubati la timbra sola ante el SAT.

records.name: MileVault
records.tagline: Automatic mileage tracker and IRS-ready reports for drivers
records.description: MileVault is the automatic mileage tracker and mileage log app for gig drivers, realtors, and the self employed. GPS trip tracking, receipt scanning with OCR, and IRS-ready tax reports, built by a real tax firm. Free on the App Store and Google Play.

records.name: foot.ink
records.tagline: Ten toenails. Ten ad slots
records.description: Ten toenails, ten ad slots. Every one opens at a dollar. Your mark goes on the gel, and the highest bid holds the nail until the first Monday of the month, when the polish comes off and it starts over.

records.name: Policyflow
records.tagline: Simple, affordable ISO compliance for growing teams
records.description: Policyflow helps compliance teams send policies, collect employee acknowledgements, and export audit-ready evidence for ISO 27001, SOC 2, NIS2, GDPR, and more.

records.name: Image Downloader - WebP, JPG, PNG
records.tagline: 1-click extension to save any image as WebP, JPG, or PNG.
records.description: Tired of saving images manually? This simple, lightweight Chrome extension lets you download any website image directly as WebP, JPG, or PNG with just one click. No manual converting needed. It’s fast, clean, and works locally in your browser to save you time.

records.name: EaziPath
records.tagline: Get end-to-end guidance for studying abroad
records.description: EaziPath helps students and professionals study, work, and relocate abroad with end-to-end support. The team manages university admissions, scholarship guidance, visa processing, flights, airport pickup, and currency exchange so you can focus on your goals. EaziPath also advises on work visas, immigration pathways, and travel and tourism, serving destinations such as China, Russia, Kyrgyzstan, Kazakhstan, and the EU. Engage their experts to plan your journey with clear steps and ongoing support.

records.name: RozmeriGPT
records.tagline: AI-powered LinkedIn comments generated instantly
records.description: RozmeriGPT is an AI-powered Chrome extension that generates professional LinkedIn comments instantly. It's built for marketers, founders, sales reps, and anyone who wants to stay active on LinkedIn without spending time thinking of the right words. Just open the extension on any LinkedIn post and get a ready-to-use comment in seconds.

records.name: Gnocortex — Architecture of a Mind
records.tagline: An AI infrastructure to map and preserve human thoughts
records.description: Gnocortex is a cognitive infrastructure that captures raw, daily thoughts and translates them into a permanent digital architecture of human intellect. Built to mitigate cognitive asset loss, the platform analyzes the semantic links and contextual evolution of your unorganized insights. Rather than creating a dead graveyard of notes, Gnocortex actively synthesizes your mental framework into an enduring, operational knowledge blueprint engineered to outlive you.

records.name: Stepwise: Step Counter Walk
records.tagline: A step counter that shows just one number
records.description: Stepwise counts your steps and gets out of the way. No account, no feed, no streaks — set a daily goal and the screen turns orange (with confetti) when you cross it. Free, with a Home Screen widget that stays live via HealthKit, not polling.

records.name: Do I Wear This?
records.tagline: Your AI outfit check before you step out
records.description: Not sure what to wear? Snap a photo, tell Do I Wear This? where you're going, and get an instant AI Fit Score, verdict, and personalized suggestions. Compare two outfits when you can't decide, then share the result with friends for a second opinion.

records.name: runto.page
records.tagline: Custom short links you can re-point. The QR never breaks.
records.description: A free URL shortener where you pick the name: runto.page/menu, not random letters. Change where a link points any time and the printed QR keeps working. Unlimited links, click counts, a free REST API. No cookies, no tracking

records.name: MonoSynth.app
records.tagline: Patch a real semi-modular synth in your browser, free
records.description: A semi-modular monosynth in a browser tab: two anti-aliased oscillators, two Sallen-Key filters, two envelopes, a mod generator and an external signal processor. The 35-socket patch bay is the point. You drag real cables, and plugging one in OVERRIDES the normalled default rather than adding to it, which is what makes a semi-modular a semi-modular and what browser synths usually skip. 35 factory patches, MIDI in, shareable patch links, a printable patch sheet. Free, no account, no install.

records.name: SoundsMac
records.tagline: Give your Mac a voice with custom sounds for everyday events
records.description: SoundsMac brings sound to everyday Mac interactions with 19 system events, 7 built-in themes, and custom sounds. Includes lid angle detection, knock detection, keyboard clicks, per-event volume controls, and more. Runs natively on macOS, completely offline, with no analytics or telemetry. Try it free for 7 days, then get lifetime access for $5. Trial code: TRIAL-V6WD6-AF87U

records.name: MyVacations
records.tagline: Plan trips, track expenses and manage your budget
records.description: MyVacations helps you organize your trips, manage your travel budget, track expenses and keep everything about your vacation in one place. Designed with offline use in mind, so you can keep managing your trip even without an internet connection.

records.name: withSolène
records.tagline: A high-EQ emotional AI companion built to listen, not fix
records.description: Most AI tools focus on speed and optimization. But when you're overwhelmed, you don't want a 5-step plan—you just want to be heard. withSolène is a high-EQ emotional AI companion built as a quiet sanctuary for the moments between therapy sessions. Instead of rushing to offer clinical advice, Kai (our active-listening AI) holds space, validates your feelings, and provides non-judgmental presence when life gets heavy. No generic scripts. No robotic disclaimers. Just room to breathe.

records.name: Foldryn
records.tagline: Free, privacy-first PDF tools that run in your browser
records.description: Foldryn is a free PDF toolkit that runs entirely in your browser — nothing you upload is ever sent to a server. It covers 11 tools: merge, split, rotate, delete, extract, and number pages, convert PDF to JPG/PNG and back, compress file size, and add watermarks. No signups, no file limits games, no watermark added to your output — just fast, private PDF editing for everyday tasks.

records.name: WeddingFlow
records.tagline: WeddingFlow is the AI Agent wedding-planning SaaS
records.description: Aria prepares proposals, SOPs, run sheets, and next steps for professional wedding planners to review, tailor, and approve. Planners keep the judgment and final say.

records.name: Gryz
records.tagline: Agent Memory you own across Claude, Cursor & MCP
records.description: Gryz gives your agents one memory you control — portable across Claude, Cursor, and other MCP clients. Preferences, decisions, and project facts stay visible, editable, and forgettable in your dashboard. Agents come and go; Gryz remembers. Free account includes MCP. Optional Quick Publish if you also want a shareable doc link.

records.name: BaZi Web
records.tagline: Free BaZi calculator and Four Pillars learning guides
records.description: BaZi Web combines a free browser-based Four Pillars of Destiny calculator with educational guides in English and Traditional Chinese. Visitors can generate a chart and explore core concepts including the Four Pillars, Five Elements, and Day Master for personal study.

records.name: Safebird
records.tagline: The AI Assistant That Makes Insurance Agents Irreplaceable
records.description: Safebird is the AI assistant built specifically for insurance sales professionals, covering the entire customer journey from first lead to long-term portfolio management. It qualifies leads, documents consultations, and grows customer intelligence in one place.

records.name: Salazar
records.tagline: Anti-raid, anti-nuke, logging, tickets — one Discord bot
records.description: Most servers run a security bot, a logging bot and a ticket bot. Salazar is all three — anti-raid, anti-nuke, full logging, verification and threaded tickets with an optional AI assistant — from one web dashboard. Free to start, €5/mo for everything.

records.name: Naymo
records.tagline: Switch Chrome tabs by voice. Say the name, you're there.
records.description: Chrome has tab search, but you still type and scan. Naymo lets you say the name out loud: press Alt+Space, say "Figma," you're there in under a second. What's different is that you save tabs by voice too. On any page say "save tab Figma" and it becomes a named shortcut, no settings panel. If that tab is closed, Naymo reopens it. Works in 10+ languages, switchable mid-session. No account, no server storing your audio. Free for 5 saved tabs, one-time purchase for unlimited.

records.name: Patitas Felices
records.tagline: AI-powered platform connecting shelters with adopters
records.description: Patitas Felices is an AI-powered platform designed to revolutionize how animal shelters connect with potential adopters. Unlike traditional classifieds or slow shelter websites, our system uses intelligent matching algorithms to pair families with the ideal pet based on lifestyle and home conditions. Key features include automated shelter management integrations, instant messaging, and automated social media outreach to maximize animal visibility and accelerate adoptions.

records.name: Package Pal for VS Code
records.tagline: AI package migration assistant inside VS Code
records.description: Stop Googling package equivalents when migrating codebases! PackagePal for VS Code is a 100% private (BYOK) AI extension that suggests target language libraries directly on hover. Powered by multi-model AI (Gemini, GPT-4o, and Claude 3.5), it delivers instant suggestions across 13 languages—complete with code snippets, companion stacks, and docs links. It also features a project-wide batch scanner and Markdown report exporter to seamlessly streamline your entire migration workflow.

records.name: UluP Spaces
records.tagline: Map your projects. No account required to start.
records.description: UluP Spaces is a visual project management tool where your work lives as a map of connected nodes instead of another endless list. Organize tasks, connect ideas, and collaborate with your team in real time — free to use.

records.name: SafeWidth
records.tagline: Check customer artwork before it goes to print
records.description: Upload a customer's file and the width it was ordered at. SafeWidth measures the detail that actually survives at that size and gives one of four answers: print as is, print smaller with the exact safe width, ask the customer for a better file with the message already written, or say it cannot be sure instead of guessing. It only changes a file when it can verify the change against the original. Built for DTF, DTG, sticker and sign shops. Checking needs no account; plans are for volume.

records.name: Vpzzo
records.tagline: Real Windows on NVIDIA L4 and L40S, billed by the minute
records.description: A GPU workstation that starts in two minutes and stops costing you anything when you turn it off. Vpzzo gives you a dedicated Windows machine on real NVIDIA hardware: L4 with 24 GB of VRAM for everyday creative work, L40S with 48 GB for heavy 3D and AI, up to eight GPUs and 384 GB of combined VRAM. A full desktop streams into a browser tab at 4K and 60 fps. The disk persists, so your apps, plugins and licences survive between sessions. Billed per minute, $0/hr while stopped, no subscription.

records.name: Karbeam
records.tagline: Turn every car in your inventory into a social reel
records.description: Karbeam turns your dealership's own vehicle listings into branded AI video reels and social carousels, automatically. Paste a listing URL from La Centrale, Le Bon Coin, AutoScout24, Mobile.de, or AutoTrader, and Karbeam pulls the specs and photos, generates a video with voiceover in your brand colors, and schedules it to Instagram and Facebook. A dashboard shows how each post performs. Built for used-car dealers and dealership groups without an in-house video editor or marketing team.

records.name: Global Business Arena
records.tagline: Run a realistic virtual company and compete globally.
records.description: Global Business Arena is a browser-based business simulation platform where players build and run realistic virtual companies from Day 1. Featuring full three-statement accrual accounting, supply chain mechanics across 76 jurisdictions, live market competition, and real-time crisis management, it turns corporate finance and strategy into a competitive sport. Designed for individual operators, entrepreneurs, and university classrooms alike.

records.name: Lead Extractor by Revolução AI
records.tagline: Local business leads, enriched and ready to message
records.description: Lead Extractor combines two prospecting engines: Google Maps, for local leads with phone and website, and Brazil's official company registry, for B2B search by industry code, size and region. Searches run on schedule, export to Google Sheets and feed WhatsApp campaigns.

records.name: CareerPocket AI
records.tagline: AI Job Tracking Copilot with Resume & Cover Letter Writer
records.description: CareerPocket AI is a privacy-first AI job application copilot. Capture a job, score your fit, tailor your resume and cover letter, and track every application in one place. Unlike standalone AI resume writers, CareerPocket keeps your career history and application workflow together, so each application starts from your real experience—not a blank AI prompt. Bring your own AI provider or use local AI with Ollama for greater control over your career data.

records.name: PaperOtter
records.tagline: 19 offline PDF tools. Nothing ever leaves your computer.
records.description: PaperOtter is a desktop app with 19 document tools, all running on your own machine. Compress a PDF to a size you name, merge, split, rotate, sign, redact and repair, and convert PDFs or Word files into Markdown, HTML or JSON with headings and lists intact, which makes them far cheaper to feed to an LLM. Nothing is uploaded: there is no network code in the document paths at all. Free, open source, offline and no account, for Mac, Windows and Linux.

records.name: SmakMail
records.tagline: Persistent mailboxes with IMAP, POP3 and API
records.description: SmakMail provides persistent receive-only mailboxes for registrations, verification codes and inbound-email automation. Buy mailboxes across multiple domain pools and access incoming messages through Webmail, IMAP, POP3 or HTTP API. Built for developers, resellers and automation workflows that need persistent mailboxes rather than disposable inboxes. Compatibility with specific third-party services is not guaranteed.

records.name: Anantya Story Weaver
records.tagline: Turn ideas into engaging stories with AI
records.description: Anantya Story Weaver is an AI-powered creative tool that helps users turn ideas, prompts, and concepts into engaging stories. Built to simplify creative writing, it demonstrates how AI and modern web technology can support accessible, practical content creation.

records.name: SnipStash
records.tagline: Stop retyping. Paste saved text anywhere on iOS
records.description: SnipStash stores the text, links, images and files you reuse, then pastes any of them into any app straight from your iPhone keyboard. Tag, search and pin them. Private iCloud sync, no accounts, no tracking. Free, or $19.99 once for Pro. No subscription.

records.name: CIVET India
records.tagline: Manufacturer of advanced filling and automation solutions.
records.description: Automatic Oil Packaging Machine (FFS) for edible oil, ghee & viscous liquids. 3 models: 15–40 BPM, ISO 9001:2015 certified. Request a quote from CIVET India.

records.name: SnapDeck — From Capture to Report
records.tagline: Screenshot it. Edit it. Done.
records.description: Most screenshot tools let you capture and annotate — but the text stays locked as an image. SnapDeck is different: it uses OCR to turn any screenshot directly into an editable PPTX or Excel file, preserving text and layout so you can edit instantly instead of retyping from scratch. No cloud upload, no subscription — just a native Mac app that's completely free. Built for anyone who's ever screenshotted a chart or slide and wished it were editable.

records.name: Habiv
records.tagline: A playful home for tiny AI-made browser games
records.description: Habiv is a home for tiny games made with AI. Play instantly in your browser, discover new experiments, chase high scores, and remix what you like. Creators can publish finished games directly from Claude Code, Codex, or any MCP-ready agent—turning a rough idea into something people can play and share.

records.name: HookEdit
records.tagline: AI video editor that cuts silence and scores your hook
records.description: HookEdit turns raw footage into ready-to-post clips for TikTok, Reels, Instagram, and YouTube. Automatic silence cut, word-by-word dynamic captions with contextual emoji, and a 0-10 Hook Score that rates how strong your first few seconds are. One upload, four aspect ratios (9:16, 1:1, 4:5, 16:9), same edit. Free while in beta, no credit card.

records.name: EstateLedger
records.tagline: Estate accounting from bank statements, to the penny
records.description: Windows desktop software for executors. Import the estate's bank-statement CSVs, reconcile every account to its date-of-death balance, review what the rules flag (subscriptions still billing the deceased, Social Security paid after death, unmatched withdrawals), and export a nine-sheet accounting workbook where every row cites its source statement line. Runs on your own computer: no account, no upload. Free to import, reconcile and review; $59 once per estate to export.

records.name: Scrapboard 4

Analysis runs in your browser. No signup, no ads, no affiliate links. Works on 17 Amazon marketplaces.

records.name: Campsend
records.tagline: The WeTransfer alternatives for agencies.
records.description: Campsend is the open-source alternative to WeTransfer. It allows you to see whether your files are opened/downloaded, create collections for your files and bring your own S3-compatible storage (S3, R2, B2) if you have data sovereignity needs.

records.name: RepoFlock
records.tagline: The Git dashboard for a fleet of repos
records.description: RepoFlock (repoflock.com) treats a whole fleet of repositories as the unit, not one repo at a time. Every repo in one window, bulk fetch, pull and push, submodule detached HEAD and pointer drift fixed in one click, and it tells you which files will conflict before you pull - not after. Local-first, no account.

records.name: Kron Sports Social Media
records.tagline: React Live. Talk Sports. No Politics
records.description: We built the sports social network that actually gets it. No politics. No algorithms burying your takes. Just real fans reacting in real time. Kron Sports Network is live on @ProductHunt today 👇 ⚡ First 100 users get an exclusive Partner Badge React. Talk. Belong. kron.social #ProductHunt #Sports #Football #NBA #F1 #MMA #Volleyball #Tennis

records.name: Chickadee Bandit
records.tagline: Chickadee Bandit: a private hub for your family, group, etc
records.description: It's a platform, not an app. Most family/household products in this space ship a fixed feature set — a shared calendar, a chore chart, a list — and iterate on it. The hub ships an operating surface: a catalog of apps that a household installs, uninstalls, and mixes. Chores, medication tracking, co-parenting agreements, HOA architectural review, and a scavenger hunt are the same kind of object to the platform. Competitors have to build each of those; the hub only has to build the contract.

records.name: nodunn
records.tagline: Recovery & Dunning for SaaS
records.description: nodunn is an autonomous recovery engine for SaaS on Stripe & Paddle. When recurring card charges fail, nodunn sends polite, founder-style emails with a 1-click passwordless update link—recovering up to 82% of lost subscription revenue on autopilot.

records.name: Videlia
records.tagline: Turn the product photos into AI model videos
records.description: AI model videos from the product photos you already have. No photoshoot, no model, no video editor. For Shopify stores selling apparel and footwear.

records.name: CareersAnalysis
records.tagline: AI-powered ATS resume optimization & career roadmaps
records.description: CareersAnalysis helps students and job seekers analyze resumes, understand ATS alignment, identify skill gaps, and build focused career preparation roadmaps.

records.name: ScrollSmack
records.tagline: Other apps report your screen time. This one interrupts it.
records.description: Pick the apps that eat your evenings and set a continuous-use limit. Cross it and one of 8 roast personas takes over your screen - the only way out is typing "I am wasting my time." No accounts, no analytics, no network permission at all. Fully offline.

records.name: Launchy
records.tagline: Load your product once. Launch it on 33+ directories.
records.description: Every launch directory asks for the same product form. Launchy stores your name, tagline, description, logo, tags and pricing once, formats them for each of 33+ platforms (Product Hunt, Peerlist, Uneed, BetaList, Hacker News, dev.to and more) and opens the submit page with the copy ready to paste. One dashboard tracks each listing as pending, submitted, live or rejected. US$39 one time, unlimited products.

records.name: FounderFlow
records.tagline: Your AI Executive Chief of Staff
records.description: FounderFlow is an AI Executive Chief of Staff that turns scattered business signals into clear priorities and next actions. It connects with Gmail and HubSpot to surface urgent messages, missed follow-ups, relationship risks, pipeline movement, and revenue opportunities. Daily briefings, Revenue Radar, Executive Memory, voice access, and evidence-backed recommendations help founders act faster, protect revenue, and scale with confidence.

records.name: DevPreFlight React UI Kit
records.tagline: 60+ Flat React 19 UI components + AI agent skills
records.description: WCAG AAA compliant, zero-bloat, flat modern component library for React 19, TypeScript, Next.js 15, and Tailwind CSS. Built for indie hackers, startups, and agencies.

records.name: My Saved Places
records.tagline: Save a place once. Open it anywhere.
records.description: My Saved Places is one private home for every location you want to remember. Save places, coordinates and recommendations, organize them into lists or trips, then open them in Apple Maps, Google Maps, Waze, Uber and more. No account, and no need to save the same address in five different apps. Now rebuilt with Apple-powered search, iCloud sync, trip lists and a visited archive.
